title: TrustReceipt
description: Cross-protocol evidence receipt for agentic commerce transactions

receipt_id.description: Unique identifier for this receipt (UUID v4)

issued_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the receipt was issued

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the receipt expires

issuer.description: Issuer domain, e.g. trusteed.xyz or merchant domain

agent_provider.description: Agent provider, e.g. anthropic, openai, google

user_intent_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the user intent text

cart_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the cart contents (optional)

order_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the order (optional)

protocol.description: Agentic commerce protocol used for this transaction

payment_reference.description: Payment processor reference (no raw payment data)

risk_signals.description: Normalized risk signals from fraud/trust providers

trust_provider_assertions.description: Assertions from trust and fraud score providers

policy_decision.description: Outcome of the policy evaluation for this transaction

verification_methods.description: Methods to verify the receipt signature

kid.description: Key ID used to sign this receipt (must match a JWKS entry)

hash_chain_prev.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the previous receipt in the audit chain (optional)

signature.description: JWS compact signature (populated when issued as JWS)

ProtocolArtifact.title: ProtocolArtifact
ProtocolArtifact.description: A protocol-specific cryptographic artifact associated with this transaction

type.description: Artifact type identifier, e.g. mcap_consent_hash, permit2_hash

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact

ref.description: Optional external reference for the artifact (e.g. on-chain tx hash)

PaymentReference.title: PaymentReference
PaymentReference.description: Payment processor reference — no raw card or account data

psp.description: Payment service provider name, e.g. stripe, mastercard, paypal

ref.description: PSP-assigned payment reference or transaction ID

RiskSignal.title: RiskSignal
RiskSignal.description: A normalized risk signal from a fraud or trust provider

source.description: Provider that produced this signal, e.g. clearsale, stripe

TrustProviderAssertion.title: TrustProviderAssertion
TrustProviderAssertion.description: An assertion from a trust, KYC, or fraud score provider

provider.description: Provider name, e.g. clearsale, trulioo, stripe_radar

assertion_type.description: Assertion category. Well-known values: kyc, fraud_score, agent_trust, payment_trust, identity. Provider-specific extensions allowed.

score.description: Normalized score in [0, 1] range (null if not applicable)

score_range.description: Human-readable score range, e.g. 0-1, 0-1000 (null if not applicable)

ts.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when this assertion was produced

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of supporting evidence (optional)

VerificationMethod.title: VerificationMethod
VerificationMethod.description: A method by which the receipt signature can be verified

value.description: Method-specific value: JWKS URL, DID, or key ID string

LiabilityContext.title: LiabilityContext
LiabilityContext.description: Liability assertion scope for this transaction

assertor.description: Entity making the liability assertion, e.g. trusteed.xyz

scope.description: Scope of the liability assertion, e.g. commerce_transaction

ConsentContext.title: ConsentContext
ConsentContext.description: User consent record bound to this transaction

consent_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the consent record

ts.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when consent was recorded

PrivacyClassification.title: PrivacyClassification
PrivacyClassification.description: Data privacy classification for this receipt

contains_pii.description: Whether this receipt payload contains personally identifiable information

retention_days.description: Required data retention period in days (optional)

jurisdiction.description: Applicable legal jurisdiction, e.g. EU, US (optional)

Attachment.title: Attachment
Attachment.description: A supporting evidence file attached to this receipt

content_type.description: MIME type of the attachment, e.g. application/pdf

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the attachment content

uri.description: Optional URI where the attachment can be retrieved
